text: Competent GIT client. This is a competent Git client  and comes with an editor for making changes to a repository. I tend to use it more for monitoring a repo than working on one  in which role it excels. Diffs are colourful  and it uses Gravatar. Of course  since it syncs the file to local storage  this is a handy offline Git client  useful with services like Github or Bitbucket when you know in advance that their native app won't be able to connect. There are a couple of minor irritations. Dates are always displayed in the US format  despite my system-wide preference for UK format. Additionally  while syntax highlighting is available in the file viewer  you must explicitly select the language every time you open a file for viewing. It doesn't use the file extension  and it doesn't remember previous choices. Secure shell works well  but you'd have to bear in mind that if you're a key user  it can't use password protected keys (as I write). All in all  I'm happy with this  and it's great for code review.
